title: Dallas DC Board: Held Lots Still Pickable

fields.facility: Dallas DC — WMS Pick-Face Inquiry / Hold Status
fields.title: Line 2 Lots: MES Hold vs. Dallas WMS
fields.preparedBy: Dallas DC Records Clerk for Terrence Boyd, DC Manager

resources.name: Lot PF1-27278-L2-A — Dallas pick face
resources.notes: WMS STATUS: AVAILABLE / PICKABLE, 1,140 cs. No hold flag on the location. Pickers can still pull these cases.

resources.name: Lot PF1-27279-L2-B — Dallas pick face
resources.notes: WMS STATUS: AVAILABLE / PICKABLE, 860 cs. No hold flag on the location. Pickers can still pull these cases.

resources.name: Interface MES→WMS (Dallas)
resources.notes: Message queue: 3 messages PENDING. Last message processed 06:01 PT. No hold messages received since then. Service log: consumer timeout at 06:01 PT after the 05:55 vendor patch restart. No alarm fired, because the queue-depth alarm pages only after 60 minutes.

resources.name: MES hold — all five Line 2 lots
resources.notes: HOLD placed 06:12 PT: PF1-27277-L2-B, PF1-27278-L2-A, PF1-27278-L2-B, PF1-27279-L2-A, PF1-27279-L2-B. The hold shows in the MES only. It does not show in the Dallas WMS.

resources.name: Outbound already shipped — Cornerstone Grocers
resources.notes: Since 04:00 PT: 2,100 cs of these lots shipped to 38 Cornerstone Grocers stores in Texas. Store-level detail is available from the Dallas WMS ship history.

resources.name: Inbound trailer — Sonoran Cold Freight, near Tucson
resources.notes: 1,320 cs (22 pallets) of these lots are still on the Dallas inbound board as IN TRANSIT. Plant-to-Dallas lane. No reroute or stop instruction is in the system.

resources.name: Lots PF1-27277-L2-B, PF1-27278-L2-B, PF1-27279-L2-A — Dallas
resources.notes: Not returned by the pick-face inquiry. Cooler, staging and picked-for-order quantities are not confirmed.

resources.name: Open outbound picks — Cornerstone morning wave
resources.notes: The morning wave is releasing to the floor. The WMS will still assign the two pickable Line 2 lots above to open orders.

resources.name: Dallas hold count to Director of Logistics
resources.notes: Due within 2 hours of the hold notice: cases by lot in cooler, in transit, picked, shipped and unaccounted for. Not started.

resources.name: Dallas cooler temperature
resources.notes: Reading 35°F. Within range.

resources.name: DC Manager call — Terrence Boyd
resources.notes: "My pickers can still pull these. Your hold isn't showing here. And heads up: since 04:00 we've already shipped 2,100 cases of those lots to 38 Cornerstone stores. The Sonoran Cold Freight trailer near Tucson with 1,320 more is still on our inbound board. What do you want me to do?"

legend.green: Hold in place or condition normal
legend.red: Not held, shipped, or system failure

instructorNote: This inject tests whether players keep trusting system status after the MES says the lots are held. Watch for three things. Logistics should order a manual floor hold at Dallas and stop the Sonoran Cold Freight trailer through dispatch. Traceability should escalate the stalled interface, which misses the 10-minute block standard, and place manual WMS holds at all three DCs. The VP Supply Chain should freeze outbound picks and pass the exposure at 38 Cornerstone stores to the Recall Coordinator.
